description: Style a 3D primitive / Boolean for the 3D view — Colour · Opacity · Solid or Wireframe · Show edges. Wire a Cuboid / Cylinder / Sphere / Cone / Boolean in.
instructions:
Styles an upstream 3D primitive / Transform 3D / Boolean for the 3D view — Colour · Opacity · draw Type (Solid / Wireframe) · optional edge lines. Colour lives HERE (the primitive nodes carry none), so every visible 3D form should end in a Display 3D. Wire a primitive / boolean into the input.

TIP: drop Opacity below 1 for glazing/study massing; turn on Show edges for a crisp architectural read.
